newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SJ says Swebus sale to bring in 1.2 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: SJ says Swebus sale to bring in 1.2 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish state railways company SJ said on Tuesday the sale of its Swebus bus unit to the British bus operator Stagecoach would bring in around 1.2 billion crowns.

"The deal will give us about 1.2 billion crowns. The figure we will present at the news conference at 1100 GMT will be higher, but is reduced by the fact that Stagecoach will take over debts," SJ spokesman Bjorn Hallden told Reuters.
Hallden said that the deal was being signed "right now", and declined to provide more details.

Stagecoach said in July it would sign a letter of intent with SJ subsidiary Swedcarrier to buy Swebus, the Nordic region's largest bus company with around 3,500 buses in operation in Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark.
